# Asia evening rendering regression sample

This sample preserves an already public report and its reviewed chart payload from
commit `66a74f5` in `quant-intel-platform`, originally published for 2026-09-24.
It is fixed test input, separate from the rotating five-date publication window.
It covers breadth, financing, turnover, money flow, distributions and six-dimension
rendering. It is not a current market report and must not be imported for publication.

History tests deliberately remap this input to explicit test report identities.
